# Original SQL completion results

42 cases generated by `tests/java/SqlCompletionGolden.java`, compiling the actual
original SqlCompletionEngine.java. The generator reads the original SqlEditorPane
keyword array and supplies deterministic catalog data. No JavaFX, databases,
user configuration or clipboard are used. Runtime Rust code uses no Java.

SHA-256:
- Original SqlCompletionEngine.java: `5223E956F83C92D8735F2932498404C88A65A9706E55615DBDE67BFEF80ED800`
- Original SqlEditorPane.java: `767AF5F2EE33C5D0E63A57A45A904615A78DDD2448DFC72546EE9998AC81D998`
- java-golden.json: `DEFF4777967A08B6CF1B62FACFD61F40074D451BED346A2142E63B3F42C952D9`

Compile the engine and generator with JDK 25 and Gson 2.11 on the classpath.
Run SqlCompletionGolden with the original SqlEditorPane.java path and destination
JSON path. Cases cover quoted qualified names, namespace/table precedence,
invalid references, Chinese, UTF-16 scanning, Java case-insensitive ordering,
case deduplication and the 100-result limit. These are pure-engine results;
window appearance and actual server catalog collection have separate tests.
